plan.purpose: evaluate the unchanged run-2 rule on previously uninspected experiments
plan.commissioning: Each channel uses its own first 100 snapshots; this evaluates a commissioning procedure, not transfer of a fitted run-2 amplitude baseline.
plan.selection: No retuning after inspecting either run; report missing data and failures.
plan.labels: Endpoint observations only; no healthy-window or fault-onset labels.
plan.release: Research evaluation only. Production acceptance thresholds and independent assurance remain unresolved.
